verdict.rationale: Convertio documents a dedicated Image Converter and broad coverage of more than 300 formats, so basic image conversion is directly supported. However, the specific formats in the story are never named. Quality and settings controls are documented only for the video converter, and that does not transfer to images. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of PNG/JPEG/WebP/HEIC/SVG support, documented image quality/size/compression controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, common image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) convert with control over quality, size, and compression

citations.quote: We support more than 25600 different conversions between more than 300 different file formats.
